en: The Triplet on the Visible and the Dyad on the State of Being a Refuge.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and with-conflict, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and without-conflict by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are six; under predominance-condition there are six … pe … under non-disappearance-condition there are six.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and without-conflict, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, reactive, and without-conflict by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are three … pe … under non-disappearance-condition there are three.
(The “Conascent” chapter … pe … and the “Associated” chapter are also similar to the “Dependent” chapter.)

A state that is visible and impinging, and non-conflict, is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a state that is not visible and impinging and is non-conflict. (Abbreviated. Regarding the object: nine;

regarding predominance: nine; regarding proximity and contiguity: three; regarding dependence: three; regarding decisive support and prenascence: nine; regarding dissociation: three ... pe ... regarding non-disappearance: nine.
(Just as the positive, negative, positive-negative, and negative-positive enumerations were calculated for the Positive Section of the Faultless Triplet, so should they be calculated here.)
